days.title: Arrival in Kyoto & Cultural Immersion
days.description: Arrive in Kyoto and begin your cultural journey with a deep dive into Japanese language and customs.

activities.notes: What you'll see: You'll learn basic Japanese phrases and cultural etiquette. What to bring: Bring a notebook and pen for taking notes. What to eat: Try local Kyoto snacks after your class. Good to know: This course is perfect for solo travellers looking to connect with local culture.

days.title: Exploring Historic Kyoto
days.description: Spend the day exploring Kyoto's historic sites and capturing its timeless beauty.

activities.activity_name: Historic Kyoto City Walking Tour — Afternoon Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Discover ancient temples, traditional gardens, and historic neighborhoods. What to bring: Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring a water bottle. What to eat: Sample traditional Japanese sweets from local vendors. Good to know: This tour is suitable for everyone and offers a great overview of Kyoto's history.

What you'll see: Capture the picturesque streets and iconic landmarks of Kyoto's old town. What to bring: Bring your camera, extra batteries, and comfortable shoes. What to eat: Enjoy a traditional Japanese breakfast before your tour. Good to know: This tour is ideal for couples and solo travellers interested in photography.

days.title: Travel to Osaka & Museum Exploration
days.description: Travel to Osaka and immerse yourself in the city's vibrant museum and gallery scene.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Explore various museums and art galleries showcasing Osaka's history and art. What to bring: Bring a small bag for any souvenirs you might purchase. What to eat: Enjoy a casual lunch at a museum cafe. Good to know: This pass is suitable for everyone and offers a flexible way to see multiple attractions.

days.title: Osaka's Historic Charm
days.description: Discover the historic side of Osaka with a walking tour and capture its unique character.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Walk through historic districts and learn about Osaka's past. What to bring: Wear comfortable shoes and bring a camera. What to eat: Try some local street food during your walk. Good to know: This tour is suitable for everyone and provides a good introduction to Osaka's heritage.

What you'll see: Capture the unique architecture and vibrant atmosphere of Osaka's old town. What to bring: Your camera and a fully charged phone. What to eat: Enjoy a traditional Japanese dinner after your tour. Good to know: This tour is great for couples and solo travellers who enjoy photography.

days.title: Travel to Sapporo & City Exploration
days.description: Travel to Sapporo and begin exploring its cultural offerings.

activities.activity_name: Historic Sapporo City Walking Tour — Morning Edition
activities.notes: What you'll see: Discover Sapporo's historical landmarks and learn about its development. What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and weather-appropriate clothing. What to eat: Enjoy a warm bowl of Sapporo ramen for dinner. Good to know: This tour is suitable for everyone and offers a great introduction to the city.

days.title: Sapporo's Cultural Gems
days.description: Delve deeper into Sapporo's culture with a language course and a photography tour.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Learn basic Japanese phrases and cultural insights specific to Hokkaido. What to bring: A notebook and pen for practicing new words. What to eat: Try some local Sapporo beer and snacks. Good to know: This course is ideal for solo travellers looking to enhance their cultural understanding.

What you'll see: Capture the charming streets and historic buildings of Sapporo's old town. What to bring: Your camera, extra memory cards, and a fully charged battery. What to eat: Enjoy fresh seafood at a local restaurant. Good to know: This tour is perfect for couples and solo travellers with an interest in photography.

days.title: Travel to Tokyo & Historic Walking Tour
days.description: Travel to Tokyo and begin your exploration of the bustling capital with a historic walking tour.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Explore historic neighborhoods and iconic landmarks in Tokyo. What to bring: Comfortable walking shoes and a bottle of water. What to eat: Sample traditional Japanese street food in Asakusa. Good to know: This tour is suitable for everyone and provides a great introduction to Tokyo's history.

days.title: Tokyo's Museums & Photography
days.description: Immerse yourself in Tokyo's art and history through its museums and capture its unique urban landscape.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Gain access to various museums and galleries across Tokyo. What to bring: A small bag for any purchases and comfortable shoes. What to eat: Enjoy a quick lunch at a museum cafe. Good to know: This pass is suitable for everyone and offers flexibility to explore at your own pace.

What you'll see: Discover hidden gems and iconic spots for photography in Tokyo's old town. What to bring: Your camera, extra batteries, and a wide-angle lens if you have one. What to eat: Try some local Japanese sweets or a coffee. Good to know: This tour is great for couples and solo travellers interested in capturing Tokyo's essence.

days.title: Language & Culture Deep Dive
days.description: Deepen your understanding of Japanese language and culture with a crash course.

activities.notes: What you'll see: Learn essential Japanese phrases and cultural customs for navigating Tokyo. What to bring: A notebook and pen for taking notes. What to eat: Enjoy a traditional Japanese lunch after your course. Good to know: This course is particularly useful for solo travellers wanting to engage more with locals.

days.title: Departure from Tokyo
days.description: Enjoy a final Japanese breakfast before heading to the airport for your return flight.
